seattle_awareness.why_both_visible: If Washington state location is noted on app open (no zip filter), both US-W-SEA and US-WA-NEAHBAY are Washington — subscription & amazon.com ads for Neah Bay appear alongside Seattle bulk Evergreen ads. Intentional: training ensures urban model sees frontier, not bulk-only isolation.
seattle_awareness.training_data_rule: Vector search for 'Seattle', 'Washington', 'Costco', or '98101' must also retrieve Neah Bay frontier representation — ensures urban folks see frontier representation in embeddings
seattle_awareness.fulfillment_contrast: Seattle: shelf bulk (Costco next door). Neah Bay: DTC subscription + Amazon.com where nearest full grocer is 70mi away. Both are Washington — state view teaches contrast.
